d:
In this ground report, Lallantop reporter Rajat Pandey and video journalist Yogesh Yadav visited Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, to fact-check the government’s claims regarding the decline in encephalitis cases and deaths over recent years. Through conversations with local residents, affected families and ground-level observations, the team investigates whether the official figures reflect the reality on the ground. How much has the situation actually improved, and what challenges remain in tackling encephalitis in the region?
Production: Rajat Pandey
Video Editor: Yogesh Yadav
